description: This file defines error codes, error handling structures, and function declarations for error management in the libgit2 library.

methods.name: giterr_last
methods.description: Returns the last error object generated for the current thread or NULL if no error has occurred.

methods.name: giterr_clear
methods.description: Clears the last library error for the current thread.

methods.name: giterr_set_str
methods.description: Sets the error message string for the current thread, specifying the error class.

methods.name: giterr_set_oom
methods.description: Sets the error message to a static value indicating memory allocation failure.
